question: Choose the word most nearly similar in meaning to 'Budding'.
explanation: Budding – उभरता हुआ; नवोदित; विकसित होना शुरू हुआ. Word Tone: Positive. Example: The budding artist won her first award. Hindi: उभरती कलाकार ने अपना पहला पुरस्कार जीता। Option meanings: A. Experienced – अनुभवी; B. Established – स्थापित; C. Emerging – उभरता हुआ; D. Mature – परिपक्व
